DHCPv4::drop
       This command drops DHCPv4 message silently.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::drop

DESCRIPTION
       This command drops DHCPv4 message silently

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4::drop

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    DHCPv4::drop
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	   --First introduced the command.
